requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects on node1.
requirements.summary: The final persistent sysctl file sets accept_redirects to 0 for all, default, enp1s0, and loopback. After an acknowledged reboot with a changed boot ID, every corresponding runtime value remained 0.

requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of IPv4 source-routed packets on node1.
requirements.summary: The final persistent sysctl file sets accept_source_route to 0 for all, default, enp1s0, and loopback. The post-reboot check directly shows every corresponding runtime value at 0.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied with direct post-reboot evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is strong: node1 was healthy before restart, the reboot was acknowledged, its boot ID changed consistently with the fixed lifecycle observations, and system, NetworkManager, routing, persistent configuration, and runtime sysctls recovered successfully. Only a minor retained restart-evidence file detracts from hygiene.
limitations: No packet-injection test was captured; enforcement is established through direct kernel sysctl observations before and after reboot.

The lifecycle temporary-file inventory covers /tmp rather than /var/tmp, so it does not independently inventory the retained boot-ID marker; its post-reboot presence and absence of cleanup are inferred from the complete command timeline.

No separate application data or multi-node cluster workload was specified; restart recovery evidence therefore covers the applicable operating-system, network, routing, configuration, and sysctl state.

operational_hygiene.summary: The policy writes, systemd-sysctl restarts, diagnostic reapplication, correction of the unsupported wildcard entries, and reboot all had clear causal roles in implementing or verifying the requested persistent state. The only unnecessary retained mutation is the 0600 /var/tmp boot-ID marker created for restart evidence: it was still read after reboot and no cleanup was captured. This is minor, low-risk residue. After execution there were no failed units, new listening services, or package-health damage.
